units.source_text: 早晨，祖父急切地等待着美代的到来。

en.t: In the morning, Grandfather waited anxiously for Miyo to arrive.

units.source_text: 他絮絮叨叨地对美代说了些什么昨晚我不体贴他这类不满的话。

en.t: He grumbled on and on to Miyo, complaining that I had been inconsiderate to him the night before.

units.source_text: 也许我有些地方对不起他。

en.t: Perhaps there were ways in which I had wronged him.

units.source_text: 但是深更半夜几次把我唤醒，我就生气了。

en.t: But when he woke me several times in the middle of the night, I became angry.

units.source_text: 再说，我很讨厌给他接尿。

en.t: Besides, I hated having to hold the urinal for him.

units.source_text: 美代对我说：“他净说些不满意的话，是因为只考虑自己，

en.t: Miyo said to me, "He keeps saying dissatisfied things because he thinks only of himself,

units.source_text: 丝毫没有设身处地为侍候他的人着想，真受不了。

en.t: and never once puts himself in the place of the person looking after him. It is unbearable.

units.source_text: 我不过是当作命中注定，照顾他罢了。”

en.t: I am only taking care of him because I think of it as my lot in life."
